findings.evidence: Empty INDEX list is reachable: pkg/parser/parser.y:3227 (ANALYZE ... INDEX IndexNameList) + pkg/parser/parser.y:9917 (IndexNameList can be empty). Planner treats IndexNames empty as buildAnalyzeAllIndex (pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:3095) which for v2 delegates to buildAnalyzeTable (pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:2872). For tables whose public indexes are all special-global, buildAnalyzeFullSamplingTask sets needAnalyzeCols=false (pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:2385, pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:2469) and then only generates IdxTasks by looping over as.IndexNames (pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:2531), so with an empty list no tasks are produced.
findings.fix: In pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:2531 handle the len(as.IndexNames)==0 case when needAnalyzeCols==false by iterating tbl.TableInfo.Indices (public) and generating tasks for each special-global index; alternatively force needAnalyzeCols=true when IndexNames is empty so it falls back to full analyze + special-global index tasks.
findings.impact: `ANALYZE TABLE t INDEX` can silently do nothing (no ColTasks/IdxTasks), leaving special global index stats missing/stale; optimizer may keep pseudo/old stats, causing plan/perf regressions and user-visible semantic surprise.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked upstream/master@3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd: the needAnalyzeCols==false branch still only loops over as.IndexNames, so empty INDEX list can still yield zero tasks.
findings.verify: Create a partitioned table whose only public indexes are special global (e.g., a single global prefix or global expression index), set @@tidb_analyze_version=2, run `ANALYZE TABLE t INDEX;`, then check mysql.stats_histograms/mysql.stats_buckets for index stats rows for that index (and/or SHOW ANALYZE STATUS). Expect stats to be updated; current code leaves them unchanged.
findings.what: AnalyzeV2: `ANALYZE TABLE ... INDEX` with an empty index list becomes a no-op when all public indexes are special global indexes.

findings.evidence: Index-only special-global index analyze path: needAnalyzeCols = !(as.IndexFlag && allSpecialGlobalIndex) (pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:2469); when false it creates only global-index IdxTasks (pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:2531). AnalyzeIndexExec marks v2 global-index results as ForMVIndexOrGlobalIndex (pkg/executor/analyze_idx.go:92-94). SaveTableStatsToStorage then updates only mysql.stats_meta.version (no snapshot/count) for such results (pkg/statistics/handle/storage/save.go:154-156, pkg/statistics/handle/storage/save.go:184-193), so an index-only analyze does not advance mysql.stats_meta.snapshot and also bypasses the snapshot-based stale-write guard.
findings.fix: Refine v2 concurrency/meta handling for global-index-only results: e.g. (1) apply the stale-write guard to all v2 results using `snapshot > results.Snapshot` (not `>=`) so same-snapshot tasks aren’t skipped, and don’t bypass it for ForMVIndexOrGlobalIndex; (2) split MV-index vs global-index flags so global-index tasks can avoid count/modify_count updates but still update/advance stats_meta.snapshot when they are the only tasks in the statement (or emit a dedicated meta-only update task).
findings.impact: Concurrent analyze ordering can break: a newer index-only special-global-index analyze may not be reflected in stats_meta.snapshot and can be overwritten by an older long-running full analyze, causing global-index stats to regress and leading to unstable/incorrect cost estimates and plan regressions.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked upstream/master@3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd: pkg/executor/analyze_idx.go still sets ForMVIndexOrGlobalIndex for v2 global index; pkg/statistics/handle/storage/save.go still avoids snapshot updates for that flag and still uses `snapshot >= results.Snapshot` gating with bypass.
findings.verify: Single-session check: compare `mysql.stats_meta.snapshot` for the table before/after `ANALYZE TABLE t INDEX idx_special_global;` under v2—snapshot will not advance. Concurrency check: run a slow `ANALYZE TABLE t` in one session (older snapshot) and after it starts run `ANALYZE TABLE t INDEX idx_special_global` in another session; when the slow analyze finishes, verify whether the special global index stats/histogram version reflect the newer index-only analyze or were overwritten by the older full analyze.
findings.what: AnalyzeV2: index-only analyze of special global indexes writes index stats without advancing stats_meta.snapshot, undermining snapshot-based concurrent-analyze correctness (stale overwrites possible).

subject: *: AnalyzeV2 supports processing special global indexes (#56115)
summary: Commit adds special-global index detection and routes them to independent v2 AnalyzeIndex tasks. Two High issues remain: (1) `ANALYZE TABLE ... INDEX` with an empty index list can generate zero tasks (silent no-op) when all public indexes are special global; (2) index-only special-global-index analyze does not advance `mysql.stats_meta.snapshot` and bypasses the snapshot stale-write guard, allowing out-of-order concurrent analyze writes to regress global-index stats.
